phaseAssignment.parityInteger: unsigned integer value of first digest byte

rootRanking.selection: lexicographically minimum digest among eligible candidate roots

sourceReplay.prng: mulberry32 seeded by decimal source seed
sourceReplay.pathIdentity: canonical move identities joined by newline
sourceReplay.terminal: source trajectory ineligible if assigned-phase root unavailable
sourceReplay.relayLimit: source trajectory ineligible; continue within frozen seed block

candidateRootEligibility: rootRawSha256 not in upstream identity firewall
sourceTrajectorySha256 not in upstream identity firewall
openingPrefixSha256 not in upstream identity firewall
prohibitedSelectionInputs: resource size of bounded root reconstruction
measurementFailureAfterSelection: STAGE1-TECHNICAL-INVALID / NO ROOT REPLACEMENT / NO SAME-EVIDENCE RERUN
